name: WPOptimizers – Image Optimizer Lite
author: WPOptimizers

sections.description:
WPOptimizers – Image Optimizer Lite is a fast, lightweight WordPress plugin that automatically compresses and optimizes your images using smart API-based compression — helping you improve page speed, Core Web Vitals, and SEO rankings without any technical setup.

Whether you’re a blogger, business owner, or developer, this plugin handles image optimization in the background so you don’t have to.

Why WPOptimizers Lite?

Unlike bulky image optimization plugins that require complex configurations, WPOptimizers Lite is designed for users who want a simple, free, and effective solution:

– No complicated setup needed to get started
– Automatically optimizes images on upload
– Reduce image file sizes by up to 70% without visible quality loss
– Works with any WordPress theme, plugin, or page builder
– Clean, beginner-friendly admin interface
– No extra server load — API handles the compression

Features

  • One-click bulk optimization – optimize your entire media library instantly
  • Auto-optimize on upload – every new image is compressed automatically
  • JPEG, PNG & GIF support – covers all common image formats
  • Media Library badge – instantly see which images are optimized or pending
  • Animated progress bar – real-time bulk optimization progress
  • Proper status saving – optimization status persists after page refresh
  • Core Web Vitals improvement – faster LCP and better PageSpeed scores
  • WooCommerce & page builder compatible – works with Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, and more

Pro Version (Coming Soon)

A Pro version with advanced features including WebP conversion, custom compression levels, CDN integration, and priority support is currently in development.

If you need a fast, lightweight, and beginner-friendly WordPress image optimizer, WPOptimizers Lite is the perfect starting point to make your website load faster and rank higher.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wpoptimizers-image-optimizer-lite directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WPOptimizers from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Start optimizing your images with one click!
sections.faq:
Will this plugin slow down my site?

No. WPOptimizers Lite is lightweight and optimized for performance. It runs efficiently in the background without adding extra load to your server.

Do I need an API key or account to use this plugin?

No. WPOptimizers Lite works out of the box — no API key, signup, or third-party service required.

Is there a limit on how many images I can optimize?

No, you can optimize unlimited images without restrictions in the Lite version.

Does it work with WooCommerce or page builders?

Yes! The plugin works seamlessly with WooCommerce, Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, and all major page builders and themes.

Will my images lose quality after optimization?

No. The plugin uses smart compression technology to reduce file size while preserving image quality. Your images will look visually the same.

Can I optimize existing images in my media library?

Yes, you can bulk optimize your existing images directly from your WordPress dashboard with one click.

Is this plugin free?

Yes! WPOptimizers Lite is completely free. A Pro version with advanced features is currently in development.
